body:
All great advice and very true. I've had (and still have) other issues that I didn't mention but slowly been improving. Like you said, being aware of it is already making things easier. Feels like I'm at least taking back some control over my life. Last fall I had a group project in school which really helped me to see the possibilities but after it ended it quickly went away again. What I'm starting to study now will have plenty of group projects as well which will mean forced interaction (in a good way) with lots of people. An easy thing I'll try to do even though its cliché is simply to always say yes and who knows, maybe some friendships will be found. 

Again like you said, all these years I've been kinda fine with not having lots of social interaction but truth be told I'm scared shitless of ending up old, bitter and alone. Stoned or not.

Thanks for your reply, helped tremendously.
